title: Breuer-Major-Donsker invariance principle
summary: We prove a Breuer-Major-type Donsker's invariance principle for stationary Gaussian sequences under the natural \emph{finite-variance assumption} on the test function. This result, which we call the \emph{Breuer-Major-Donsker} principle, or simply the \emph{BMD principle}, removes the additional moment assumption imposed in the functional Breuer-Major theorem of Nourdin and Nualart (\emph{Probab. Theory Related Fields}, 2020). Our method does not rely on the Malliavin-calculus estimates used by Nourdin and Nualart, in particular Meyer's inequality. Instead, it is based on a…
